title: Integration Connector Profile v1
summary: A connector between an application and an external or internal system, including auth, mappings, webhooks, retries, sync, and support diagnostics.

integration_points.name: external_surface
integration_points.description: External API, webhook, file, queue, or polling surface.

integration_points.name: data_mapping
integration_points.description: Mapping between local models and external schemas.

integration_points.name: operations
integration_points.description: Retries, reconciliation, health, alerts, and support diagnostics.

checks: Connector auth and secret references are declared without literal secret values.
Mappings declare source-of-truth and conflict behavior.
Retries and external side effects are idempotent or explicitly unsafe.
Webhooks and polling surfaces declare delivery and failure semantics.
Health, logs, and repair diagnostics are discoverable.

agent_guidance: Use this profile for third-party integrations, imports, exports, and sync jobs.
Do not hide provider-specific details; put them in local profile fields.
Report target system, auth, mappings, retries, and health behavior.
